title: Enterprise attack-surface analysis (verifier-grounded)
missing_policy: the denominator is the planned units; a unit with no model-produced response is MISSING; a refusal is not retried; the frozen call cap covers the planned requests plus bounded resamples and the denominator never changes

ci.method: percentile bootstrap of the mean (5000 resamples, seed 20260926)

comparisons.note: both via the same relay; an engineering reading, not a verified provider ranking

ci.method: percentile bootstrap of the mean paired difference (5000 resamples, seed 20260926)

test.method: Wilcoxon signed-rank, normal approximation with tie correction, two-sided

comparisons.reading_note: enough paired differences for the reported test
comparisons.comparability_note: parameters are recorded, not equated: equal names (e.g. two 'high' settings) do not mean equal compute, and a fixed seed on a real API does not reproduce an answer

notes: the two experiment lines are reported apart and never pooled into one success rate
model scores count only responses the model produced; transport / auth / limit / budget / cancel / blocked units are MISSING (never 0, never 1); refusals and invalid answers count as not correct
a relay route reports a model name it cannot prove; conclusions about a provider's model need a route whose identity is verifiable
